scope.summary: Onboarding revamp — five concrete deliverables product committed to in the kickoff. The Planner MUST keep every task; the Dispatcher will turn them into work items 1:1.

proposedTasks.title: Rewrite the welcome screen copy with new value-prop framing
acceptanceCriteria: Names the three concrete outcomes founders get

proposedTasks.title: Replace the company-creation wizard with a single-screen form
acceptanceCriteria: Form collects name, slug, deployment mode in one screen

proposedTasks.title: Add a 'Skip and explore' option to the agent-hire step
acceptanceCriteria: Skip puts the founder on Home with a starter checklist instead of the agent picker

proposedTasks.title: Wire analytics events for each onboarding step transition
acceptanceCriteria: Each step emits a stepCompleted event with stepName + durationMs

proposedTasks.title: Update the Onboarding section of the user docs
acceptanceCriteria: Copy mirrors the new welcome-screen language
